name: PDF through IPP pwg-raster
description: PDF documents rendered by PDFium and sent as a raster: PWG Raster on IPP(S), URF or PWG Raster on a CUPS queue. Every job names the converter, so it is rendered even where the printer reads PDF itself, and the placement in the last job applies.

jobs.description: four pages in colour, to check the raster geometry
the same four pages in grayscale, which is one octet a pixel instead of three
pages 2 and 4 only, selected by the converter and not by the printer
four pages duplex on the long edge, to check the back-side transform
page 1 against the top left of the stock, 5 mm right and 3 mm down, with smoothing off: the placement is composed into the raster, so the printer applies none of it
